composition_subtypes.role: Preprocess exams by sorting according to (a_i, b_i) to enable greedy processing.
Iterate exams in order and greedily choose earliest possible day (b_i if >= current, else a_i).

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting by a_i enables greedy scheduling that minimizes final exam day while preserving record order.
payload.rationale: The solution pre-sorts exams by recorded dates to establish an order where later exams have larger a_i, then greedily assigns actual days to minimize maximum day. Two distinct algorithm families are combined.
